chapter: Buck and Bubbles: Nazarro and Bubbles
title: Bubbles halves the tempo for rhythm tap
summary: Green explains Bubbles cut up-tempo tap in half to a moderate tempo with richer patterns and demonstrates.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: What was this dance that Bubbles did? I mean can you show me that? Can you demonstrate that type of cutting and -- cutting time down, doing twice as many steps? What was that?

Well, what it was is -- during that time tap dance was an up tempo music. The music was kind of fast, you know, pieces of 'Bye-Bye Blue,' you know, and 'Liza' and 'See You in My Dreams' and pieces like that, fast tempos, you see.

So Mr. Bubbles, he cut the tempo in half and went into 4/4 time, which was -- that's a moderate tempo, rhythm, you see. And in that way, if I could be allowed to stand up here and maybe I could demonstrate some of the Bubbles sounds.
